questions.question: Match the 2011 paper's pairs: (a) Salt Satyagraha, (b) protest against the Devadasi system, (c) Neil Statue Satyagraha, (d) The Hindu. Match with (1) Dr Muthulakshmi Reddy, (2) N. Somayajulu, (3) Kasthuri Ranga Iyengar, (4) Vedaranyam.

text.en: Match the 2011 paper's pairs: (a) Salt Satyagraha, (b) protest against the Devadasi system, (c) Neil Statue Satyagraha, (d) The Hindu. Match with (1) Dr Muthulakshmi Reddy, (2) N. Somayajulu, (3) Kasthuri Ranga Iyengar, (4) Vedaranyam.

questions.editorialExplanation: Vedaranyam is associated with Salt Satyagraha; Dr Muthulakshmi Reddy with opposition to the Devadasi system; N. Somayajulu with Neil Statue Satyagraha; and Kasthuri Ranga Iyengar with The Hindu.

questions.question: Choose the chronological sequence of Indian freedom-struggle movements.

options.A: Quit India → Non-Cooperation → Khilafat → Civil Disobedience
options.B: Civil Disobedience → Khilafat → Quit India → Non-Cooperation
options.C: Khilafat → Non-Cooperation → Civil Disobedience → Quit India
options.D: Non-Cooperation → Quit India → Khilafat → Civil Disobedience

text.en: Choose the chronological sequence of Indian freedom-struggle movements.

en.A: Quit India → Non-Cooperation → Khilafat → Civil Disobedience
en.B: Civil Disobedience → Khilafat → Quit India → Non-Cooperation
en.C: Khilafat → Non-Cooperation → Civil Disobedience → Quit India
en.D: Non-Cooperation → Quit India → Khilafat → Civil Disobedience

questions.editorialExplanation: The movements began broadly in the sequence Khilafat (1919), Non-Cooperation (1920), Civil Disobedience (1930) and Quit India (1942).

questions.question: A dataset of 50 observations has standard deviation 6.5. If 5 is added to every observation, what does the paper list as the new standard deviation?

text.en: A dataset of 50 observations has standard deviation 6.5. If 5 is added to every observation, what does the paper list as the new standard deviation?

questions.editorialExplanation: Adding the same constant to every observation does not alter standard deviation, so it remains 6.5. None of the listed options gives 6.5; TNPSC accepts all options and this item is ungraded.
